name: Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest
      - name: Install
        working-directory: code
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build pele-markdown
        working-directory: code/packages/pele-markdown
        run: bun run build
      - name: Build site
        working-directory: code/site
        run: bun run build
      - name: Build pitch deck
        working-directory: code/pitch
        run: bun run build
      - name: Assemble
        run: |
          mkdir -p public
          cp -r code/site/.vitepress/dist/. public/
          mkdir -p public/pitch
          cp -r code/pitch/dist/. public/pitch/
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: public

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

I fixed issue #1, where the logo image overlapped the navigation bar on screens narrower than 960px. It's committed as `4794225` with "Fixes #1" in the message, but not pushed.

**Cause:** below 960px, VitePress pulls the hero image up under the navigation bar (a negative top margin of 76px, or 108px on wider phones). That margin is sized for VitePress's own image box, which has empty space around a small picture. Our site styles that image as a big poster card with no empty space, so the pull put the card on top of the nav links.

**Fix:** in [custom.css](code/site/.vitepress/theme/custom.css), on screens under 960px only, I removed that negative margin, let the image box size to the poster, and centered the poster above the headline. Before, it sat off to the left.

I checked screenshots at 390, 600, 880 and 1280px wide on a local preview of the site. The poster now sits below the navigation bar at all of them, and the desktop layout at 1280px looks the same as before.
